_comment: 示範團章（節錄 3 章），只作教學用途；真實團章請用自己旅團嘅 data/units/<編號>/constitution.json

preamble.zh: 呢份係示範團章，用嚟試編輯、發布版本、輸出 Word / PDF 同 QR Code。真實使用時請以自己旅團嘅團章為準。
preamble.en: This is a demo constitution for testing editing, publishing, Word/PDF export and QR codes.

articles.zh: 本團定名為「示範旅團深資童軍團」。
articles.en: The Unit shall be titled the “Demo Venture Scout Unit”.

articles.zh: 團員大會每年召開一次，定於每年 7 至 8 月舉行。
articles.en: The General Meeting shall be held once a year, between July and August.

articles.zh: 司庫須保存所有收支紀錄及單據，並於每次執委會會議提交月結。
articles.en: The Treasurer shall keep records of all income and expenditure and present a monthly report at each Executive Committee meeting.

blocks.zh: 制服規定詳見旅團通告。
blocks.en: Uniform requirements are as announced by the Unit.

footer.zh: 示範旅團團章（示範資料）
